# Garmin MCP by geekist.co

Live MCP endpoint: `https://garmin.geekist.co/mcp`.

Connect a compatible MCP client to Geekist's Garmin service and follow the client's authentication flow. The server exposes the tools available to your account; review a tool's effect and confirm any requested Garmin change in your client before it is made.

The included Garmin Review skill guides activity, trend, workout and supported change requests. Tool availability and client compatibility can vary. For setup guidance, see the package distribution README.
